svg.title: Controlled Workspace publication responsibilities
svg.desc: The Desktop and Workspace process call a small Controlled Product Data interface. Internal coordination validates Reservation and expected-head rules, stages candidate bytes through a storage adapter, and publishes through one authoritative database commit. A status query resolves an uncertain response by the same OperationId.
